question: If cosec θ = 1(7)/(22), find the value of cot² θ.
solution:
**Given:**

cosec θ = 1(7)/(22)

**Concept used:**

Cotθ = Base/perpendicular

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c221d424197a25df79f44595c95f9a15f32356bdf5c0adfbc9347ed550336b5b.png] 

Here 

cosec θ = 1(7)/(22)

cosec θ = 29 / 22

Then Base will be ,

⇒ √(29² - 22² ) 

⇒ √(29 - 22 ) (29 + 22)

⇒ √(7 ×51) = √(357)

So Cotθ = √(357) / 22

Cot²θ = (357)/(484)

**∴ The correct option is 2**
